name: soia-dsh-safe-tool-call-policy
description: DSH host policy plugin that matches bash, write, and edit calls against a shipped danger-pattern list before they execute, asking for confirmation or denying with a one-line compliant alternative. Registers no tool and no prompt section.

tokenBudget.note: hook-only: registers no tool and no prompt section, so resident model-visible text is zero. A blocked call adds only that call's one-line reason to its own result.
